description.short_caption: Fungal growth with aerial hyphae on a culture plate.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a culture plate with a prominent fungal growth. The colony exhibits a raised, stalk-like structure with a bulbous tip, characteristic of aerial hyphae or sporulating structures. The surrounding area appears to have a dense, white, cottony texture, typical of fungal colonies. The image is focused on the fungal morphology, suggesting a possible identification of the organism based on its macroscopic appearance.
